journeys.outcome: A learner can open a real algorithm, control its visualization and reach a meaningful practice checkpoint in the first learning session.

steps.expected_state: visual learning method and free entry are visible
learner can select and manipulate a free algorithm visualization
server-visible simulation request can return the selected algorithm trace when the route is used
lesson combines visualization, explanation, complexity and practice

journeys.outcome: A learner interaction can produce aggregate activation/practice evidence without treating browser activity alone as retained learning success.

steps.expected_state: learner performs a real lesson or practice interaction
allowed aggregate learning event is accepted when configured
later learning-session state is distinguishable from first-session activation

journeys.outcome: A paid course entitlement may be activated only after authoritative external payment evidence exists; source/UI state alone cannot claim a sale.

steps.expected_state: commercial offer and current external checkout readiness are represented truthfully
approved payment provider returns authoritative verified payment evidence; until then this step is blocked_external
server-side entitlement is issued only from accepted payment truth
paid lesson trace access reflects server-side entitlement rather than client-only state
